description: This file defines the EmployeeContactDetailsController class within the OrangeHRM project. The class manages the pre-rendering setup for employee contact details, including initializing Vue components and handling permissions based on employee number retrieved from HTTP requests.

classes.name: EmployeeContactDetailsController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for preparing employee contact details view, fetching necessary data, and setting permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with employee contact data and permissions based on the employee number from the request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups relevant for permission checks related to contact details.
